article.headline: Isaac Hawkins scores 26 to help Utah Valley fend off Nevada 73-71
article.description: — Isaac Hawkins scored 26 points as Utah Valley turned back Nevada 73-71 on Saturday night.
article.linkText: Isaac Hawkins scores 26 to help Utah Valley fend off Nevada 73-71

categories.description: Utah Valley Wolverines @ Nevada Wolf Pack

event.description: Utah Valley Wolverines @ Nevada Wolf Pack

keywords: Utah Valley Wolverines @ Nevada Wolf Pack
article.story: RENO, Nev. -- — Isaac Hawkins scored 26 points as Utah Valley turned back Nevada 73-71 on Saturday night. Hawkins added five rebounds and three blocks for the Wolverines (3-0). Dominick Nelson scored 14 and grabbed six rebounds. Isaac Davis had 10 points and shot 5 of 7 from the field. Styles Phipps led the Wolf Pack (2-2) with 18 points, six assists and two steals. Peyton White contributed 17 points and 10 rebounds. Hawkins led Utah Valley with nine points in the second half. Phipps missed a 3-pointer on the game's final shot. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
